term: non-theistic openness to an ultimate beyond nature
definition: Withholding belief in a personal God is compatible with investigating a nonpersonal religious ultimate and does not entail that nature is all there is. This positive inquiry stance supplies no completed causal theory of the universe or moral ontology.
